scenes.omni_prose_prompt: An extreme macro 100mm camera shot frames the intricate technical fabric weave from <image_1> resting on the titanium stage of <image_2>. Filmed at 1.0x real-time speed with rigid physics, the intertwined matte-black carbon yarns and luminous cyan microfibers sit in sharp stillness for the first three seconds under deep blue lab lighting. At second 03, mechanical tension applies from the edges, causing the interlocking threads to pull taut with realistic elasticity, elongating slightly without tearing or morphing. A crisp emerald laser scan line sweeps smoothly across the surface at second 06, catching the micro-ridges of each fiber in tack-sharp focus. Synchronized diegetic audio layers a deep, tactile microfiber stretch sound, a soft pneumatic pressure release, and high-precision electronic equipment hum.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Add visible micro-dust particle displacement upon tension snap.

White condensation streamlines wrap smoothly over the taut fabric sheet with zero turbulence.
The fabric ripples rhythmically with high-frequency aerodynamic waves.
scenes.kinetic_contact_chain: Nozzle airflow discharge -> Air pressure boundary layer forms -> Fluid-structure interaction on fabric -> Aerodynamic ripple wave propagation -> Stable laminar wave state.
scenes.omni_prose_prompt: The camera executes a smooth backward robotic dolly move at 1.0x real-time playback speed, transitioning from macro into a medium-wide shot of the aerodynamic wind tunnel test bench from <image_2>. At second 09, high-velocity laminar airflow surges from the circular intake nozzle: smooth, parallel ribbons of white condensation smoke glide over the taut cyan-and-black fabric sheet matching <image_1>, adhering perfectly to its surface without turbulent separation. The fabric vibrates with ultra-precise, high-frequency aerodynamic micro-ripples, displaying authentic mass and aerodynamic resistance. The robotic camera holds a perfectly stabilized low-angle tracking position. Synchronized diegetic audio captures the rising pneumatic whoosh of high-speed laminar wind, deep acoustic turbine hum, and the rapid, crisp fluttering friction of synthetic fabric in air.

Laser illumination reveals vortices rolling smoothly off the trailing edge.

scenes.omni_prose_prompt: A dynamic lateral tracking arc shot sweeps 90 degrees around the testing rig at natural 1.0x speed. The technical fabric sheet, mounted on a sleek carbon-fiber arm like <image_3>, flexes smoothly under extreme aerodynamic pressure into a graceful, low-drag winglet profile. Twin violet laser sheets slice across the trailing edge, illuminating micro-vortices of smoke that curl gracefully off the fabric lip without fluttering into chaotic turbulence. The fabric springs back into its pristine planar resting position with a satisfying tactile snap.
Laser illumination freezes on the pristine weave as smoke gently dissipates into stillness.

scenes.omni_prose_prompt: The camera punches in smoothly on the fabric center from the front at 1.0x real-time speed. At second 27, the wind tunnel turbines instantly power down with a solid acoustic drop: the high-speed smoke ribbons dissipate into thin air, and the flexed fabric springs crisply back to its initial flat resting plane with a singular, satisfying physical SNAP. The material settles instantly into flawless, motionless stillness, its black-and-cyan weave catching the steady ambient blue glow of the lab with razor-sharp macro clarity. Zero camera drift and zero digital artifacting. Synchronized diegetic audio captures the heavy pneumatic clunk of the wind valves closing, the crisp, singular SNAP of the taut textile rebounding, and the smooth decay of turbine whine into dead-silent lab room tone.
